itemDropMultiplier.label: Item drops
itemDropMultiplier.description: Ruthless item-drop quantity, as a share of the server's ordinary drop system.

equipmentRarityMultiplier.label: Equipment rarity
equipmentRarityMultiplier.description: Multiplier of the chances of magic, rare and unique equipment.

gemExperienceMultiplier.label: Gem experience
gemExperienceMultiplier.description: Share of ordinary gem experience from kills.

vendorRewardMultiplier.label: Vendor rewards
vendorRewardMultiplier.description: Share of basic vendor-sale rewards; ordinary multi-item recipes stay disabled.

experiencePenaltyStartLevel.label: Experience penalty from level
experiencePenaltyStartLevel.description: First character level affected by the extra player-experience penalty.

experienceMultiplierPerLevel.label: Experience per penalty level
experienceMultiplierPerLevel.description: Factor compounded once at the start level and once for each level after it: 0.90 gives 90% at the start level, 81% one level later.

campaignBossLifeRecoveryFraction.label: Boss life on player death
campaignBossLifeRecoveryFraction.description: Share of maximum life a nearby campaign boss recovers when the player dies.
